newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia, Qatar to raise capital of joint bank.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia, Qatar to raise capital of joint bank.

text.p: Tunisia and Qatar will raise the capital of their joint bank Banque Tuniso-Qatari d'Investissements (BTQI) by 15 million dinars ($16.5 million) to 50 million dinars, official and banking sources said on Monday.
They also decided to launch a bond issue worth 12 million dinars to be subscribed half/half by the two countries.
BTQI bankers told Reuters the bond issue was planned for 1998 and would be for a three of five-year maturity. The increase in the capital was expected to be subscribed this year, they added.

The agreement was signed last Friday in Tunis by Qatari Finance, Economy and Trade Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Khalifa al-Thani and Tunisian Finance Minister Mohamed Jeri on the fringes of a visit to Tunis by Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani.
BTQI results for 1996 showed a net profit of 500,000 dinars, up from 300,000 dinars in 1995.
The Tunis-based offshore bank was established in 1983 to finance Tunisian development projects. ($=1.1 dinar)
